row.notes: mov rdx,[rax] (3 bytes) in Game_CareerEventsSequencer_Initialise (+0x1020) right after the call to Game_CareerEventTable_CollectMatchingRecords (0x140c72e93, rcx = pointer vector at [rsp+0x98]); rax = [rsp+0xa0] = the vector's begin, read as the first collected record to name the team mate asset group (add rdx,0x50; 0x1423dbcf0; 0x140c808e0). Begin is 0 when no record of the career event table matches the session's event record (its +0x5e is 0x3fff, or the equality 0x14309c1e0 fails), which faults reading 0x0. Core hooks it and, for rax == 0, sets rip to site_Game_CareerEventsSequencerRecordsJoin.
